entries.usage_goal: Add a self-contained browser about page that keeps Router.back navigation, resource-backed branding, and simple two-column layout composition inside one render-facing page shell.
blocking_constraints: Keep Router.back wiring, resource-backed branding content, and same-file layout composition source-backed inside the page boundary; do not invent helper coordinators.
